summary: V50.z257 Tour Guidato conversazionale — BACKEND fully validated (7/7 pytest passed): GET /tour/features returns 7 groups (CRM/Energia/Documenti/AxonOS/Comunicazioni/Master/Impostazioni), unauth → 401. POST /tour/profile with 3-answer payload returns 3-4 valid features + non-empty reply from Claude Haiku LLM (session ~3-8s), legacy {text:...} variant also OK, empty answers → 400. POST /tour/contact-from-text extracts first_name='Mario', phone, email correctly from Italian dictated string; too-short text → 400. FRONTEND: Step 1 UI renders correctly on mobile viewport 390x844 (tour-root, tour-step-1, tour-start, tour-features-link, tour-skip all visible; 'Benvenuto in AdvisorOS.' heading present). Step 2 UI reaches successfully via tour-start; tour-q-1/voice/type-toggle/skip-2 visible; 'Domanda 1 di 3' text present; typed input flow works (tour-type-toggle → tour-type-input → tour-type-send fills user bubble tour-a-1, then tour-q-2 appears with 'Domanda 2 di 3', repeat for tour-q-3 with 'Domanda 3 di 3'). Skip flow: tour-skip on step 1 remained on /tour (potential nav issue but same as observed in iter84 — router.replace may be delayed on web). NOT VALIDATED end-to-end via UI: LLM reply appearance (tour-reply), features-lit progression, step 3 contact flow, step 4 finish redirect — because API calls from the app returned 401 in headless Playwright: AsyncStorage-web token injection via localStorage/IndexedDB did not propagate to the useAuth context in this environment. The token DOES work when set via direct UI-login (iter84 pattern), so this is a testing-harness limitation, not an app bug. Backend confirms all endpoints work correctly with proper Bearer auth.

integration_issues.flow: Tour step 2 → 3 → 4 (LLM reply + contact save + finish)
integration_issues.issue: NOT VALIDATED end-to-end in headless Playwright due to AsyncStorage-web auth token injection not propagating; requires real UI login (email/password page) with PointerEvent dispatch as documented in iter84. Backend LLM endpoints are confirmed working via pytest.

action_items: Main agent: consider running a manual self-test of the full 4-step tour flow via the UI (browser) to confirm the LLM/features-lit progression, contact preview save, and tour-finish redirect + PUT /user-settings onboarding_done=true. Backend contracts are already verified: GET /tour/features (200, 7 groups), POST /tour/profile (200, 3-4 features + reply, saves user_settings.tour_profile), POST /tour/contact-from-text (200, extracts first_name/phone/email), all with correct 400/401 error paths.

For next testing agent: to test the full tour flow via Playwright, log in through the actual /login screen with PointerEvent dispatch on the login-submit Pressable — do NOT inject the token via localStorage/IndexedDB. The token must be written by the app's own setToken() to be picked up by useAuth.
critical_code_review_comments: axon_tour.py:88 saves user_settings.tour_profile via upsert (correct). LLM catalog list is inlined and stable — good. Falls back to _tour_heuristic if <3 picks, guaranteeing 3-4 features returned even on LLM failure.
axon_tour.py:97 _llm_extract_contact is reused from the biglietto-da-visita module (12_ai_contact_copilot); on failure falls back to naive first_name/last_name split of text — acceptable degraded UX.

tour.tsx:39 useEffect writes onboarding_done_${user_id} to AsyncStorage as SIDE EFFECT on mount BEFORE the tour even starts. Means if the user opens /tour once (even by mistake) and backs out, the tour won't reappear. Design choice — flagging for main agent's awareness.

tour.tsx:54 finish() fires-and-forgets api('/user-settings', PUT onboarding_done:true) with .catch(()=>{}) — silent failure. If the API call fails, backend state and local cache diverge (the local device shows tour as done, but the server thinks not-done). Consider await + retry.

tour.tsx:22 speak() function calls /assistant/tts on every question — on web headless this fails silently (documented). On low-bandwidth mobile users this adds ~1s latency per question with no meaningful UX benefit if TTS fails. Consider making it opt-in.

tour-features.tsx renders an ActivityIndicator forever if /tour/features fails hard (catch sets empty array so it eventually renders empty groups). Empty groups state has no explicit copy — user sees only 'Tutte le funzioni' title + footer. Acceptable but consider adding an inline retry.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (step 1 + step 2 partial UI verified; steps 3–4 + LLM reply flows blocked by test-harness auth injection)

seed_data_creation: None. Test creates a Giulia Verdi contact via POST /contacts only during step-3 tour flow (which was NOT reached end-to-end in this session) — no orphaned data. Backend pytest suite creates no persistent data other than transient user_settings.tour_profile write (already scoped to owner and idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AsyncStorage web IN THIS APP uses window.localStorage (see /app/frontend/node_modules/@react-native-async-storage/async-storage/lib/module/AsyncStorage.js: uses window.localStorage) with key 'auth_token_v1' storing JSON.stringify(token). BUT injecting via localStorage.setItem before navigation still resulted in 401 for /tour/features and /tour/profile — probably because useAuth() reads token on module mount and does not re-check. The RELIABLE pattern is UI login (as iteration_84 did): navigate to /login (or index which redirects there), fill login-email/login-password via HTMLInputElement value setter + dispatch input, then PointerEvent-dispatch (pointerdown+mousedown+pointerup+mouseup+click) on login-submit Pressable, wait for /home redirect, then reset onboarding_done=false via fetch and navigate to /tour. All tour testIDs verified to exist in /app/frontend/app/tour.tsx.
